name: Appartements Obwaller
beschreibung: The Appartements Obwaller in Söll (Tirol) consist of several holiday apartments. The accommodation is situated in a quiet location on the outskirts, and the center is within walking distance. Each apartment is equipped with a kitchen, a living area, and a bathroom. Free Wi-Fi and parking are available. There is a sauna area for shared use. In winter, the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area is nearby; in summer, hiking and other activities are possible in the surrounding area.
